desc: Fruit trees (scripts/home/fruit_tree.gd). A tree you put down grows from a sapling over grow_secs of real time (it keeps growing while you are away). Once grown it swells one fruit every fruit_secs, which drops to the grass; at most max_fallen lie there. Walking up to the tree picks them for the pantry; a hungry Boki walks to them and eats one first.
grow_secs_doc: Seconds from put down until the tree is grown and starts to fruit.
stage_at_doc: Share of grow_secs at which the tree is a sapling, a young tree and grown.
stage_scale_doc: Model size per stage, 1.0 = a full tree.
fruit_secs_doc: Seconds a grown tree takes to swell and drop one fruit; it stops while max_fallen lie on the grass.
max_fallen_doc: Most fruit waiting under one tree.
reach_doc: Metres from the fallen fruit within which your feet pick it up.
